{"addr": "0x140618b1e", "comment": "Load step 1, PrepareForLoad (35779): VM frozen, master file loads cancelled, queued model handles dropped, audio killed, menus closed. Runs after the save's plugin list checked out (ReadPluginList)."}

{"addr": "0x140618c86", "comment": "Load step 2: global data tables 0-8, 100-114, 1000-1005 (LoadGlobalData), then the change forms loop below: per form, header, LookupFormByID, vfunc 0x90 (InitLoadGame)."}

{"addr": "0x140619046", "comment": "Load step 3: forms the running game changed that the save does not list are reverted (RevertFormsNotInSave): an in-game load is a revert plus the save's changes, not a restart of the world."}
{"addr": "0x140619237", "comment": "Load step 4: second pass over the change forms, vfunc 0x78 (LoadGame) with each form's data."}

{"addr": "0x1406192fd", "comment": "Load step 5: InitAndFinishLoadedForms(wait=1): vfunc 0x80 per form, then blocks on the IO manager (75708) until the queued cell and model loads are in, then vfunc 0x88 (FinishLoadGame). The cell load's wait is here, on the main thread."}
{"addr": "0x14062815c", "comment": "Load step 6, FinishLoad: master file loads resume, terrain manager update, nearby actor list, story teller, VM thawed (54016)."}
{"addr": "0x140615cf0", "comment": "wait=1 (a save's load): the IO manager drains its queue here (75708, priority 5) before FinishLoadGame runs on each form."}
